gloss: starring role; lead role; to star in

definitions.gloss: starring role; lead role; to star in
definitions.explanation: playing the main or leading role in a film, play, or other performance

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}に{主演|しゅえん}する。
{主演|しゅえん}{俳優|はいゆう}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{初|はつ}{主演|しゅえん}を{務|つと}めた。
examples.english: She took on her first starring role.

notes:
USAGE:
- {主演|しゅえん}する (to star in)
- {主演|しゅえん}を{務|つと}める (to take on the starring role)
- 〜{主演|しゅえん} (starring ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主演|しゅえん}{俳優|はいゆう}/{女優|じょゆう} (lead actor/actress)
- {主演|しゅえん}{映画|えいが} (movie in which one stars)
- W{主演|しゅえん} (double leads, co-starring)
- {初|はつ}{主演|しゅえん} (first starring role)

OTHER ROLES:
- {助演|じょえん} (supporting role)
- {共演|きょうえん} (co-starring)
- {出演|しゅつえん} (appearing in, performing)

RELATED:
- {主役|しゅやく} (protagonist, main character)
- {出演|しゅつえん} (appearing, performing)
- {共演|きょうえん} (co-starring)
